title: Path to $3.22 — what the market price implies (reverse DCF)
reading: At r=15%, g=10%, the $3.22 price needs retained revenue of $182,930,687/yr — 7.7x today's R₀. At the current 31.64% capture and 16.50 bps fee rate that means $350.4B of annual Intents volume (7.7x today's annualised volume), or $48,180,227 of gross fees every 30 days. Capture alone cannot get there: with volume flat, the price needs a 243% capture rate — impossible. Even at 100% capture with volume flat, the DCF ceiling is $1.32 (41% of the price). The price is a bet on volume growth, not on retention.
